sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • The following tests ARE REIMBURSABLE for any of these conditions: bleeding, inflammation, itching, pain, pelvic infection, pregnancy with history of pre-term labor, redness and vaginitis: – Aptima® BV Assay (CPT code 81513**) – BD MAX™ Vaginal Panel (CPT code 81514**) – Direct probe deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) based identification of Gardnerella (CPT code 87510*), Trichomonas (CPT code 87660*) and Candida (CPT code 87480*) – Nucleic acid amplification testing (NAAT) or polymerase chain reaction (PCR) based identification of Gardnerella vaginalis (CPT code 87511*, CPT code 87512*) – NAAT or PCR based identification (CPT code 87661*) of Trichomonas vaginalis – PCR based identification of Candida (CPT code 87481*, CPT code 87482*) – Testing for the presence of amines (CPT code 82120) – Xpert® Xpress Mutliplex Vaginal Panel (MVP) (CPT code 81515***) • Screening for Trichomonas (CPT code 87660*, CPT code 87661*) IS REIMBURSABLE for any of the following risk factors: – Exchange of sex for payment – History of sexually transmitted infections (STIs) – Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) – Incarceration – Injection drug use – New or multiple partners • For asymptomatic individuals, including asymptomatic pregnant individuals at an average or high risk for premature labor, screening for trichomoniasis or bacterial vaginosis (CPT code 87480*, CPT code 87510*, CPT code 87661*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • Rapid identification of Trichomonas by enzyme immunoassay (CPT code 87808) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . Applicable procedures for Medicare Advantage plans
